title: Scaffold a CocoKits package or entry point

name.description: Package or entry point name: utils|shared for shared-lib, the tool name for tool (required), the module for cdk-module, the machine for machine, the component for fw-entry and angular-testing. Optional for cdk, machines, fw-core, fw, theme-core and theme-fw (the canonical project name is used; a different value is rejected).

framework.description: Framework of fw-core, fw, theme-fw, fw-entry and angular-testing (angular-testing is always angular).

theme.description: Theme name for theme-core and theme-fw.
